# Lifehacker

> > Lifehacker provides practical tips, how-tos, and news about technology, productivity, security, and digital life hacks.

Lifehacker covers the latest developments in consumer technology from companies like Google, Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon, with a focus on helping readers navigate software updates, AI features, security threats, and digital tools. The site features writers including Jake Peterson and Emily Long who explain tech trends, product launches, and privacy concerns in accessible language.

## Key Topics

- AI features and tools (Nano Banana, Gemini)
- Google products (Android, Google Photos, Gmail)
- Apple ecosystem (iOS, iPhone, Apple Watch, watchOS)
- Microsoft services (Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook)
- Privacy and security threats
- Virtual try-on and AI shopping
- Wearables and health tracking
- Software updates and beta features
- Cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure)
- 2FA and authentication security
- Pixel devices and features
- AI-generated content detection
- Phishing and malware protection
- Digital productivity tools

## Security and Privacy Alerts

- [The 'Pixnapping' Attack Can Steal Your 2FA Codes](https://lifehacker.com/tech/pixnapping-new-android-malware-attack): Pixnapping malware steals 2FA codes from Android via pixel-scanning attack
- [Check This Database to See If Your Email Credentials Have Been Leaked](https://lifehacker.com/tech/leaked-email-credentials-in-database): Security researcher compiles 183M leaked email credentials in searchable database
- [This New Hotel Reservation Scam Is Fooling People Who Use Sites Like Booking.com](https://lifehacker.com/money/hotel-reservation-scam): Phishing scam targets Booking.com and Expedia users with fake payment alerts
- [How to Stop This New Pixel Bug From Leaking Your Audio to Incoming Callers](https://lifehacker.com/tech/pixel-bug-take-a-message): Pixel's Take a Message feature has privacy bug leaking audio to callers

## AI and Machine Learning

- [Google Will Now Let You Virtually Try on Clothes With Just a Selfie](https://lifehacker.com/tech/google-virtually-try-on-clothes-with-selfie): Google's AI-powered virtual try-on uses selfies to generate full avatars
- [All the New AI Features Coming Soon to Google Photos](https://lifehacker.com/tech/google-photos-is-rolling-out-new-ai-features-today): Google Photos adds Nano Banana AI editing and Gemini-powered features
- [This Trend Is Making It Even Harder to Tell When a Video Is AI-Generated](https://lifehacker.com/tech/those-ai-videos-might-actually-be-real): Sora watermarks on real videos blur line between AI-generated and authentic
- [Amazon's Alexa+ Has Three New Personalities to Choose From](https://lifehacker.com/tech/amazon-alexa-three-new-personalities): Alexa+ adds Brief, Chill, and Sweet personality options for Echo devices
